articles.title: Gold, silver prices next week: What investors should watch amid global uncertainty
articles.summary: Gold and silver prices are anticipated to remain range-bound with modest support from rupee fluctuations. Investors will focus on upcoming inflation data from India, China, and the US.

articles.title: Rupee relief, higher hedging costs: What RBI’s new forex rules mean
articles.summary: Reserve Bank of India has introduced new measures aimed at stabilizing the Indian rupee against the dollar. These changes include tighter restrictions on foreign exchange derivatives and new reserve requirements for banks.

articles.title: Homebuyer paid Rs 39.15 lakh but got no flat; RERA rejects builder's excuse orders interest payout
articles.summary: The homebuyer alleged that the builder had invoked the PMRDA-PMC jurisdiction dispute only after the delay happened, using it as an excuse to explain why the flat had not been handed over to the buyer on time.

articles.title: Crude oil outlook: US-Iran talks, supply risks likely to keep prices volatile
articles.summary: As talks between the US and Iran unfold regarding the strategic Strait of Hormuz, crude oil prices are poised for fluctuations. Market experts suggest that a successful diplomatic resolution might lower prices, though persistent regional tensions could sustain high levels.

articles.title: Stock market is crashing, yet IPOs attract billions: What’s happening here?
articles.summary: Foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) invested $1 billion (Rs 9,676 crore) in IPOs in September even as they sold $4.8 billion (Rs 45,537 crore) worth of listed equities, the highest monthly outflow since April 2026, when they withdrew $6.7 billion (Rs 63,167 crore).

articles.title: Inflation data, IT earnings, crude oil to steer stock markets this week, say experts
articles.summary: Anticipation is high in Indian stock markets as volatility and consolidation loom, particularly with September's inflation data on the horizon. These figures will shed light on price movements and may sway the Reserve Bank of India's policy decisions.

articles.title: ‘To be finalised in line with changed circumstances’: Piyush Goyal on India-US trade deal
articles.summary: India and the US are finalizing their interim trade agreement framework, as circumstances have changed since February. Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal indicated that negotiations would consider recent shifts in the US tariff landscape.

articles.title: Despite promise, builder denied disabled parking to Rs 1.03 crore flat buyer; RERA orders relief
articles.summary: In one such case, a woman and her family bought a 3BHK ( 3 Bedrooms, Hall, Kitchen) from a builder in Bengaluru for Rs 1.03 crore. The builder promised two specially enabled parking spaces, and it was supposedly one of the property's key attractions.

articles.title: India’s money supply growth hits 17.3%: Why expert warns of inflation risks
articles.summary: Steve Hanke said India’s M3 money supply was growing at 17.3% annually, while its six-month annualised growth rate stood at 20.2% and the three-month annualised rate at 31.5%.

articles.title: Make in India: Why India’s manufacturing gains look stronger against a turbulent decade
articles.summary: India’s share of global manufacturing value added rose from 2.4% in 2014 to 3% in 2025, an improvement that the authors say compares favourably with Brazil, Mexico, Indonesia and South Africa.

articles.title: Man faces Rs 17.18 lakh tax penalty over Rs 55.62 lakh unexplained deposits; ITAT gives relief
articles.summary: A man had not filed an income tax return for assessment year 2016-17. The tax department subsequently completed a reassessment without his participation and, on February 15, 2024, assessed his total income at Rs 55.62 lakh.

articles.title: RBI's rupee defence: Special dollar window for oil firms, tighter forex derivative rules
articles.summary: The RBI has announced a series of measures to ease pressure on the rupee. The steps aim to curb speculative activity, reduce dollar demand in the spot market and limit currency volatility as the rupee trades near its record low against the US dollar.

articles.title: RBI opens special dollar window for three state-run oil companies from October 12
articles.summary: Under the arrangement, the RBI will sell US dollars to the three public sector oil companies through designated banks. The facility is intended to ensure that the companies can meet their full daily foreign currency requirements for their operations.
